```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  AlertTriangle,
  ArrowLeft,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  FileText,
  Save,
  User,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

// Mock data para la alerta
const mockAlert = {
  idxmonitoringalert: 1,
  monalertname: "High CPU Usage Alert",
  monalerttype: "TYPE1",
  monseverity: "HIGH",
  monstatus: "ACTIVE",
  mondescription: "CPU usage has exceeded 90% threshold for more than 5 minutes",
  monalertdata: '{"cpu": 92, "threshold": 90}',
  montriggeredat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  monacknowledgedat: null,
  monacknowledgedby: null,
  monresolvedat: null,
  monresolvedby: null,
  monresolutionnotes: null,
  monmetadata: '{"source": "system", "component": "api-server"}',
  moncreatedby: "system",
  moncreatedat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  monupdatedby: null,
  monupdatedat: null,
};

export default function MonitoringAlertDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState(mockAlert);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const navigateBack = () => {
    router.back();
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    // TODO: Implementar guardado
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string | null) => {
    if (!dateString) return "N/A";
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString("es-ES");
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const variants: Record<string, "default" | "destructive" | "secondary"> = {
      ACTIVE: "destructive",
      INACTIVE: "secondary",
      PENDING: "default",
      REJECTED: "destructive",
    };
    return variants[status] || "default";
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
          <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        </div>
        <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="flex items-center justify-between"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={navigateBack}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.title", "Detalle de Alerta")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t(
                    "monitoring.alerts.detail.description",
                    "Gestión y configuración de alerta de monitoreo"
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)}>
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={handleSave}>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}>
                {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Main Card */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.information", "Información")}
                </CardTitle>
                <Badge variant={getStatusBadge(alert.monstatus)}>
                  {alert.monstatus}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {/* Alert Name */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.alertName", "Alert Name")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      value={alert.monalertname}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monalertname: e.target.value })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{alert.monalertname}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Alert Type */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.alertType", "Alert Type")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <select
                      className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                      value={alert.monalerttype}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monalerttype: e.target.value })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="TYPE1">Tipo 1</option>
                      <option value="TYPE2">Tipo 2</option>
                      <option value="TYPE3">Tipo 3</option>
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{alert.monalerttype}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Severity */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.severity", "Severity")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      value={alert.monseverity}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monseverity: e.target.value })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{alert.monseverity}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Status */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.status", "Status")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <select
                      className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                      value={alert.monstatus}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monstatus: e.target.value })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="ACTIVE">Activo</option>
                      <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivo</option>
                      <option value="PENDING">Pendiente</option>
                      <option value="REJECTED">Rechazado</option>
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant={getStatusBadge(alert.monstatus)}>
                      {alert.monstatus}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Description */}
                <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.description", "Description")}
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Textarea
                      value={alert.mondescription}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, mondescription: e.target.value })
                      }
                      rows={4}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm">{alert.mondescription}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Alert Data */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.alertData", "Alert Data")}
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      value={alert.monalertdata}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monalertdata: e.target.value })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-mono text-xs bg-muted p-2 rounded">
                      {alert.monalertdata}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Timestamps Section */}
              <div className="border-t pt-6 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.timestamps", "Timestamps")}
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.triggeredAt", "Triggered At")}
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-sm">{formatDate(alert.montriggeredat)}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.acknowledgedAt", "Acknowledged At")}
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-sm">{formatDate(alert.monacknowledgedat)}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <User className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.acknowledgedBy", "Acknowledged By")}
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-sm">{alert.monacknowledgedby || "N/A"}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.resolvedAt", "Resolved At")}
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-sm">{formatDate(alert.monresolvedat)}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Resolution Notes */}
              {alert.monresolutionnotes && (
                <div className="border-t pt-6 space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.alerts.detail.resolutionNotes", "Resolution Notes")}
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Textarea
                      value={alert.monresolutionnotes}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setAlert({ ...alert, monresolutionnotes: e.target.value })
                      }
                      rows={4}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm">{alert.monresolutionnotes}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
const mockMetric = {
  idxmonitoringmetric: 1,
  monmetricname: "API Response Time",
  monmetrictype: "PERFORMANCE",
  monmetricvalue: 245.5,
  monmetricunit: "ms",
  monmetricstatus: "ACTIVE",
  mondescription: "Average response time for API endpoints",
  monmetricdata: '{"endpoint": "/api/v1/models", "avg": 245.5}',
  moncollectedat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  monmetadata: '{"source": "api-gateway"}',
  moncreatedby: "system",
  moncreatedat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  monupdatedby: null,
  monupdatedat: null,
};

export default function MonitoringMetricDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState(mockMetric);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const navigateBack = () => {
    router.back();
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string | null) => {
    if (!dateString) return "N/A";
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString("es-ES");
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6">

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (

      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />

      </div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="flex items-center justify-between"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={navigateBack}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <BarChart3 className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.title", "Detalle de Métrica")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.description", "Gestión de métricas de monitoreo")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)}>
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={handleSave}>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}>
                {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
                {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.information", "Información")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.metricName", "Metric Name")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      value={metric.monmetricname}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMetric({ ...metric, monmetricname: e.target.value })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{metric.monmetricname}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.metricType", "Metric Type")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      value={metric.monmetrictype}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMetric({ ...metric, monmetrictype: e.target.value })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">{metric.monmetrictype}</p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.metricValue", "Metric Value")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      value={metric.monmetricvalue}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMetric({ ...metric, monmetricvalue: parseFloat(e.target.value) })
                      }
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium">
                      {metric.monmetricvalue} {metric.monmetricunit}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.status", "Status")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <select
                      className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                      value={metric.monmetricstatus}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMetric({ ...metric, monmetricstatus: e.target.value })
                      }
                    >
                      <option value="ACTIVE">Activo</option>
                      <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivo</option>
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant={metric.monmetricstatus === "ACTIVE" ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                      {metric.monmetricstatus}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.description", "Description")}
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <Textarea
                      value={metric.mondescription}
                      onChange={(e) =>
                        setMetric({ ...metric, mondescription: e.target.value })
                      }
                      rows={4}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p className="text-sm">{metric.mondescription}</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t pt-6 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
                  {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.timestamps", "Timestamps")}
                </h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {t("monitoring.metrics.detail.collectedAt", "Collected At")}
                      </Label>
                      <p className="text-sm">{formatDate(metric.moncollectedat)}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
      alert.monalertname.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      alert.mondescription.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesType = typeFilter === "ALL" || alert.monalerttype === typeFilter;

                <select
```

```typescriptreact
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder={t("monitoring.alerts.responseForm.notesPlaceholder", "Enter notes...")}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-4 border-t">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleCancel}>
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancel")}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleSubmit}
                  disabled={!decision || isSubmitting}
                >
                  <Send className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.submit", "Submit")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```

```typescript
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```

```typescript
// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Dashboard",
    "code-playground": "Code Playground",
    playground: "AI Playground",
    "model-management": "Model Management",
    serving: "Serving",
    "technology-management": "Technology Management",

    nodes: "Platform Nodes",
    updates: "Platform Updates",

    agents: "Agents",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Dashboard";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};
```

```typescript
// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Dashboard",
    "code-playground": "Code Playground",
    playground: "AI Playground",
    "model-management": "Model Management",
    serving: "Serving",
    "technology-management": "Technology Management",
    "domain-ingestion": "Domain Ingestion",
    "data-sources": "Fuentes de Información",
    admin: "Admin",
    team: "Admin",
    config: "Admin",
    "training-center": "Training Center",
    plugins: "Plugins",
    projects: "Projects",
    rag: "RAG System",
    "model-evaluation": "Model Evaluation",
    training: "AI Training",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    // NUEVAS RUTAS DEL CORE
    departments: "Departments",
    sessions: "User Sessions",
    audit: "Audit System",
    licenses: "Platform Licenses",
    nodes: "Platform Nodes",
    updates: "Platform Updates",
    // INFRASTRUCTURE
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
    agents: "Agents",
    monitoring: "Monitoring",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Dashboard";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};
```

```typescript
// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Dashboard",
    "code-playground": "Code Playground",
    playground: "AI Playground",
    "model-management": "Model Management",
    serving: "Serving",
    "technology-management": "Technology Management",
    "domain-ingestion": "Domain Ingestion",
    "data-sources": "Fuentes de Información",
    admin: "Admin",
    team: "Admin",
    config: "Admin",
    "training-center": "Training Center",
    plugins: "Plugins",
    projects: "Projects",
    rag: "RAG System",
    "model-evaluation": "Model Evaluation",
    training: "AI Training",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    analytics: "Analytics",
    // NUEVAS RUTAS DEL CORE
    departments: "Departments",
    sessions: "User Sessions",
    audit: "Audit System",
    licenses: "Platform Licenses",
    nodes: "Platform Nodes",
    updates: "Platform Updates",
    // INFRASTRUCTURE
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Dashboard";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};
```

```typescriptreact
  audlogentity: "MonitoringAlert",
  audlogentityid: 123,

};

export default function AuditLogDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [auditLog, setAuditLog] = useState(mockAuditLog);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const navigateBack = () => {
    router.back();
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string | null) => {
    if (!dateString) return "N/A";
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString("es-ES");
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const variants: Record<string, "default" | "destructive" | "secondary"> = {
      SUCCESS: "default",
      FAILURE: "destructive",
      PENDING: "secondary",
    };
    return variants[status] || "default";
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="flex items-center justify-between"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={navigateBack}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              <div>

                  {t("monitoring.auditLog.detail.title", "Detalle de Log de Auditoría")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("monitoring.auditLog.detail.description", "Información detallada del log de auditoría")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)}>
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={handleSave}>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}>
                {t("common.edit", "Editar")}

        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

  Activity,
  Calendar,
  Clock,
  FileText,
  Heart,
  Save,
  Server,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useParams, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

const mockSystemHealth = {
  idxsystemhealth: 1,
  syshealthstatus: "HEALTHY",
  syshealthcpu: 45.5,
  syshealthmemory: 62.3,
  syshealthdisk: 38.7,
  syshealthnetwork: 72.1,
  syshealthuptime: 86400,
  syshealthlastcheck: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  syshealthdetails: '{"activeConnections": 125, "requestsPerSecond": 45}',
  syshealthmetadata: '{"node": "node-1", "region": "us-east-1"}',
  syshealthcreatedat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  syshealthupdatedat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
};

export default function SystemHealthDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [systemHealth, setSystemHealth] = useState(mockSystemHealth);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  const navigateBack = () => {
    router.back();
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string | null) => {
    if (!dateString) return "N/A";
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString("es-ES");
  };

  const formatUptime = (seconds: number) => {
    const days = Math.floor(seconds / 86400);
    const hours = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    return `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  };

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const variants: Record<string, "default" | "destructive" | "secondary"> = {
      HEALTHY: "default",
      WARNING: "secondary",
      CRITICAL: "destructive",
    };
    return variants[status] || "default";
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
            <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="flex items-center justify-between"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={navigateBack}
              className="flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Heart className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("monitoring.systemHealth.detail.title", "Detalle de Salud del Sistema")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("monitoring.systemHealth.detail.description", "Información de salud del sistema")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {isEditing ? (
              <>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsEditing(false)}>
                  <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={handleSave}>
                  <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}>
                {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <Badge variant={getStatusBadge(systemHealth.syshealthstatus)}>
                  {systemHealth.syshealthstatus}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-6">
              {/* Metrics */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label>CPU Usage</Label>
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{systemHealth.syshealthcpu.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <Progress value={systemHealth.syshealthcpu} className="h-2" />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{systemHealth.syshealthmemory.toFixed(1)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <Progress value={systemHealth.syshealthmemory} className="h-2" />

                <div className="space-y-2">

              {/* System Info */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 border-t pt-6">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.systemHealth.detail.status", "Status")} *
                  </Label>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <select
                      className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"

                        setSystemHealth({ ...systemHealth, syshealthstatus: e.target.value })

                    >
                      <option value="HEALTHY">Healthy</option>
                      <option value="WARNING">Warning</option>
                      <option value="CRITICAL">Critical</option>
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant={getStatusBadge(systemHealth.syshealthstatus)}>
                      {systemHealth.syshealthstatus}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.systemHealth.detail.uptime", "Uptime")}

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />

                      {formatUptime(systemHealth.syshealthuptime)}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                  <Label>
                    {t("monitoring.systemHealth.detail.details", "Details")}

              {/* Timestamps */}

              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Eye,
  Search,
  Server,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useState } from "react";

const mockSystemAlerts = [
  {
    idxsystemalert: 1,
    sysalertname: "System Memory Critical",
    sysalerttype: "MEMORY",
    sysseverity: "CRITICAL",
    sysstatus: "ACTIVE",
    sysdescription: "System memory usage has reached 95%",
    systriggeredat: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  },
  {
    idxsystemalert: 2,
    sysalertname: "Disk Space Low",
    sysalerttype: "DISK",
    sysseverity: "HIGH",
    sysstatus: "PENDING",
    sysdescription: "Disk space below 10% threshold",
    systriggeredat: "2024-01-15T09:15:00Z",
  },
  {
    idxsystemalert: 3,
    idxsystemalert: 3,
    sysalertname: "Network Latency High",
    sysalerttype: "NETWORK",
    sysseverity: "MEDIUM",
    sysstatus: "RESOLVED",
    sysdescription: "Network latency above 200ms",
    systriggeredat: "2024-01-14T16:45:00Z",
  },
];

export default function SystemAlertsOverviewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState("ALL");

  const filteredAlerts = mockSystemAlerts.filter((alert) => {
    const matchesSearch =
      alert.sysalertname.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      alert.sysdescription.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesType = typeFilter === "ALL" || alert.sysalerttype === typeFilter;
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "ALL" || alert.sysstatus === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesStatus;
  });

  const totalItems = mockSystemAlerts.length;
  const activeItems = mockSystemAlerts.filter((a) => a.sysstatus === "ACTIVE").length;
  const pendingItems = mockSystemAlerts.filter((a) => a.sysstatus === "PENDING").length;
  const resolvedItems = mockSystemAlerts.filter((a) => a.sysstatus === "RESOLVED").length;

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    const variants: Record<string, "default" | "destructive" | "secondary"> = {
      ACTIVE: "destructive",
      PENDING: "default",
      RESOLVED: "default",
      INACTIVE: "secondary",
    };
    return variants[status] || "default";
  };

  const formatDate = (dateString: string) => {
    return new Date(dateString).toLocaleString("es-ES");
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="text-center space-y-2"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <Server className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("monitoring.alerts.systemOverview.title", "Alertas del Sistema")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            {t("monitoring.alerts.systemOverview.description", "Gestión de alertas del sistema")}
          </p>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Metrics Cards */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.2 }}
          >
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-blue-600 border-0 text-white shadow-xl">
              <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-white/90">Total</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="text-4xl font-bold">{totalItems}</div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>

          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.3 }}
          >
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500 to-red-600 border-0 text-white shadow-xl">
              <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-white/90">Activas</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="text-4xl font-bold">{activeItems}</div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>

          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.4 }}
          >
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-500 to-yellow-600 border-0 text-white shadow-xl">
              <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-white/90">Pendientes</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="text-4xl font-bold">{pendingItems}</div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>

          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.5 }}
          >
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-gradient-to-br from-green-500 to-green-600 border-0 text-white shadow-xl">
              <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-white/90">Resueltas</CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="text-4xl font-bold">{resolvedItems}</div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        </div>

        {/* Filters */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.6 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <Input
                      placeholder={t("common.search", "Buscar...")}
                      value={searchTerm}
                      onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                      className="pl-10"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <select
                  className="rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  value={typeFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setTypeFilter(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="ALL">Todos los Tipos</option>
                  <option value="MEMORY">Memory</option>
                  <option value="DISK">Disk</option>
                  <option value="NETWORK">Network</option>
                </select>
                <select
                  className="rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  value={statusFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="ALL">Todos los Estados</option>
                  <option value="ACTIVE">Activo</option>
                  <option value="PENDING">Pendiente</option>
                  <option value="RESOLVED">Resuelto</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Alerts Table */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.7 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>
                {t("monitoring.alerts.systemOverview.list", "Lista de Alertas del Sistema")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">ID</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Alert Name</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Alert Type</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Severity</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Status</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Description</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredAlerts.map((alert) => (
                      <tr key={alert.idxsystemalert} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                        <td className="p-2">{alert.idxsystemalert}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium">{alert.sysalertname}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">{alert.sysalerttype}</Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">{alert.sysseverity}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge variant={getStatusBadge(alert.sysstatus)}>
                            {alert.sysstatus}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {alert.sysdescription}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              asChild
                            >
                              <Link href={`/monitoring/alerts/system/${alert.idxsystemalert}`}>
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Link>
                            </Button>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                  className="rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  value={statusFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="ALL">Todos los Estados</option>
                  <option value="ACTIVE">Activo</option>
                  <option value="INACTIVE">Inactivo</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Metrics Table */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.5 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>
                {t("monitoring.metrics.overview.list", "Lista de Métricas")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">ID</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Metric Name</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Type</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Value</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Status</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">Description</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("common.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {filteredMetrics.map((metric) => (
                      <tr key={metric.idxmonitoringmetric} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                        <td className="p-2">{metric.idxmonitoringmetric}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 font-medium">{metric.monmetricname}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">{metric.monmetrictype}</Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          {metric.monmetricvalue} {metric.monmetricunit}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge variant={metric.monmetricstatus === "ACTIVE" ? "default" : "secondary"}>
                            {metric.monmetricstatus}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {metric.mondescription}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              asChild
                            >
                              <Link href={`/monitoring/metrics/${metric.idxmonitoringmetric}`}>
                                <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Link>
                            </Button>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm">
                              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";

import Link from "next/link";

export default function MonitoringDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const dashboardCards = [
    {
      id: "alerts",
      title: t("monitoring.dashboard.alerts", "Alertas"),
      description: t("monitoring.dashboard.alertsDesc", "Gestión de alertas de monitoreo"),
      icon: AlertTriangle,
      href: "/monitoring/alerts",
      color: "from-red-500 to-red-600",
      stats: { total: 12, active: 3, pending: 2 },
    },
    {
      id: "metrics",
      title: t("monitoring.dashboard.metrics", "Métricas"),
      description: t("monitoring.dashboard.metricsDesc", "Visualización de métricas del sistema"),
      icon: BarChart3,
      href: "/monitoring/metrics",
      color: "from-blue-500 to-blue-600",
      stats: { total: 45, active: 38 },
    },
    {
      id: "system-health",
      title: t("monitoring.dashboard.systemHealth", "Salud del Sistema"),
      description: t("monitoring.dashboard.systemHealthDesc", "Estado de salud del sistema"),
      icon: Heart,
      href: "/monitoring/distributed/system-health",
      color: "from-green-500 to-green-600",
      stats: { status: "HEALTHY", uptime: "99.9%" },
    },
    {
      id: "performance",
      title: t("monitoring.dashboard.performance", "Performance"),
      description: t("monitoring.dashboard.performanceDesc", "Métricas de rendimiento"),
      icon: TrendingUp,
      href: "/monitoring/metrics/performance",
      color: "from-purple-500 to-purple-600",
      stats: { avgResponse: "245ms", throughput: "1.2k req/s" },
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
          className="text-center space-y-2"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <Activity className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("monitoring.dashboard.title", "Dashboard de Monitoreo")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            {t("monitoring.dashboard.description", "Vista general del sistema de monitoreo")}
          </p>
        </motion.div>

          {dashboardCards.map((card, index) => {
            const IconComponent = card.icon;
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={card.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.1 * (index + 1) }}
              >
                <Link href={card.href}>
                  <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:border-primary/50 cursor-pointer h-full">
                    <CardHeader>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <IconComponent className={`w-8 h-8 bg-gradient-to-br ${card.color} bg-clip-text text-transparent`} />

                      <CardTitle className="mt-4">{card.title}</CardTitle>
                      <CardDescription>{card.description}</CardDescription>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {card.id === "alerts" && (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Total:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium">{card.stats.total}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Activas:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium text-red-500">{card.stats.active}</span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {card.id === "metrics" && (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Total:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium">{card.stats.total}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Activas:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium text-green-500">{card.stats.active}</span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {card.id === "system-health" && (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Estado:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium text-green-500">{card.stats.status}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Uptime:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium">{card.stats.uptime}</span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                        {card.id === "performance" && (
                          <>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Respuesta:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium">{card.stats.avgResponse}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Throughput:</span>
                              <span className="font-medium">{card.stats.throughput}</span>
                            </div>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </Link>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Quick Stats */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: 0.6 }}
        >
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Server className="w-5 h-5" />
                {t("monitoring.dashboard.quickStats", "Estadísticas Rápidas")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                <div className="text-center">
                  <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">12</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {t("monitoring.dashboard.activeAlerts", "Alertas Activas")}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-green-500">99.9%</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {t("monitoring.dashboard.uptime", "Uptime")}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-center">
                  <div className="text-3xl font-bold text-blue-500">245ms</div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {t("monitoring.dashboard.avgResponse", "Respuesta Promedio")}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
            "<h4>¿Qué son los Proyectos RAG?</h4><p>Los proyectos RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) son sistemas inteligentes que combinan la recuperación de información con la generación de texto. // Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```

```typescript
        projects: {
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

          title: "Create RAG Model",
          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```

## Migración completada

### Resumen de páginas creadas

#### DETAILS (7/7)
1. `/monitoring/alerts/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de alerta
2. `/monitoring/alerts/system/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de alerta del sistema
3. `/monitoring/metrics/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de métrica
4. `/monitoring/metrics/system/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de métrica del sistema
5. `/monitoring/distributed/audit-log/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de log de auditoría
6. `/monitoring/distributed/governance/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de gobernanza
7. `/monitoring/distributed/system-health/[id]/page.tsx` - Detalle de salud del sistema
